name: Vérificateur des sceaux
description: Lean old adult, ash-grey dreadlocks, pale weathered mottled head, narrow long mandibles, healed brow scar. Long tan sleeved coat open over leather travel vest, worn bronze bracers. Holding a handheld bronze seal press and one small locked supply cylinder close to chest, belt with wax-like seal pellets in closed pouches. Stooped attentive posture inspecting the lid.
prompt:

Crisp silhouette, detailed convincing textiles and weathered metal, soft overhead-left lighting. No scenery, backdrop, ground, platform, floor shadow, glow cloud, text, readable writing, numbers, labels, watermark, border, extra person, collage or atlas. No magical staff. At ordinary game sprite scale, face, posture, clothes and cargo shape must distinguish this person.
Distinct individual design: Lean old adult, ash-grey dreadlocks, pale weathered mottled head, narrow long mandibles, healed brow scar. Long tan sleeved coat open over leather travel vest, worn bronze bracers.
